calls.title: Demo Call with Allison Doucette from Synapse SEM
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted GrowthBook’s features for supporting AB testing and landing page experimentation without heavy reliance on developers. Key aspects included a visual editor that simplifies testing for marketers, AI-enhanced tools that assist in setup and analysis, and a reliable metrics integration with platforms like GA4 and BigQuery. Synapse's needs for rapid, easy landing page testing were emphasized, as well as concerns regarding design quality and brand standards. GrowthBook's pricing structure was reviewed, noting a transition from seat-based to usage-based pricing, which encourages clients to sign up beforehand. The importance of technical setup involving SDK installation was addressed, alongside strategies to streamline integration and mitigate complexity.
calls.keywords: AB testing, GrowthBook, landing pages, visual editor, GA4 integration, experiment analysis
